Hi Olivia — thanks for the context and the offer of a deposit. I’m looping in Marcus (AR) and Priyom (sales ops) so we can propose a structured path that protects both parties. High level we can do a conditional arrangement:

- First two invoices: Net60 with 2% monthly interest applied after day 60 if evidence not provided;
- Security option: refundable security deposit equivalent to one month projected spend OR a letter of credit — if Mediscape posts either, we can waive interest and move to Net45 for month 3 onward;
- VAT holdback: Redwood requires official VAT registration docs to release withheld VAT to our remittance process — we can accept scanned certificates initially but will need certified evidence within 30 days;
- Credit cap: initial credit cap set at $150k (limits to usage spikes). We can revisit after 90 days with consumption data.

Marcus, Priyom — can you confirm the interest cadence and the mechanism for posting a deposit vs L/C? Olivia — if that looks acceptable I’ll draft a short addendum and DocuSign link.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Kim / Olivia — quick notes on the mechanics from AR side:

- Interest: if invoices remain unpaid after day 60, interest accrues at 2% per 30-day period (not compounding) until settled;
- Deposit vs L/C: deposit should be wired to Redwood Treasury (we'll provide bank instr) and held as a refundable credit against future invoices. Letter of credit should be an irrevocable, standby L/C in USD in favor of Redwood Inference — our legal has a template we can send;
- Credit cap & monitoring: we will enable an alert at 80% of the $150k cap; usage beyond the cap will be blocked automatically and will require escalation to sales ops for a temporary extension;
- VAT: we can hold the VAT portion on our books and remit after we receive certified VAT registration. To avoid cashflow friction, we can accept a scanned certificate for provisional release of 50% of the VAT portion, with full release upon certified doc.

Olivia — if Mediscape prefers a higher initial cap, please state the requested amount and any supporting financial references.

Marcus Lin
Director, Accounts Receivable
